ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea wreath
ThingDef.description: The wreath is woven from Oberonia Aurea and rare silver leaf grass, full of natural beauty, and has a certain health promoting effect when worn.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Snow Fleece Hat
ThingDef.description: A thick, warm hat woven with a large amount of plush is one of the traditional warm clothing of the Oberonia Aurea Empire.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Technical Hat
ThingDef.description: The technical department uniform hat of the Oberonia Aurea Palace, with a lightweight design, does not feel heavy even when worn on the head.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea industrial protective helmet
ThingDef.description: The safety helmet used during the construction of the Industrial Department of the Oberonia Aurea Palace has a good toughness alloy and a specially designed built-in buffer layer, which can effectively protect against blunt object impacts. However, it is not effective in protecting sharp objects.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Industrial Vest
ThingDef.description: The standard work uniform adopted by the Ministry of Industry of the Oberonia Aurea Palace has weak protective properties and can carry many light tools for easy use during construction.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Cloak
ThingDef.description: The clothing produced by the Oberonia Aurea Empire after being exposed to the culture of the Milky Way is more focused on intuitive and open aesthetics compared to traditional clothing, making it more vibrant.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Mountain Windbreaker
ThingDef.description: The windbreakers specially designed by the distant travelers of the Oberonia Aurea Empire for the mountainous climate have excellent resistance to falls and cold.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Multifunctional Coat
ThingDef.description: The work uniform commonly used by the Oberonia Aurea Palace has multiple modular components that can be easily connected to the work equipment of the Oberonia Aurea . In addition, it also has certain heat resistance and protective performance.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Industrial Uniform
ThingDef.description: The standard uniform used by the Ministry of Industry of the Oberonia Aurea Palace, along with safety belts, can effectively prevent the risk of falling during construction operations. Regular communication devices and toolkits can slightly improve work efficiency.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Technical Uniform
ThingDef.description: The standard uniform adopted by the technical department of the Oberonia Aurea Palace has a thick skirt pressure that provides certain protection and thermal insulation performance. The technical tools on the belt can provide certain support for technical work.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Technical Officer Uniform
ThingDef.description: The uniform customized by the Jin Yuan Lan Palace for technical officials has a more complex production process compared to the normal technical department uniform. In addition, in order to facilitate the management of personnel by technical officers, this uniform focuses on strengthening communication and management capabilities. \n\nUnits within 15 squares of the wearer will receive an increase in work speed.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Technical Officer Coat
ThingDef.description: The Oberonia Aurea Palace is a coat specially developed for technical officials, with little consideration for practicality, but more emphasis on comfort and aesthetics when wearing it.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Duplex Dress
ThingDef.description: One of the common Oberonia Aurea costumes, the multi-layered duplex structure is highly layered, and the carefully designed patterns are no less impressive than palace costumes.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Classic Robe
ThingDef.description: It is one of the common clothes of Oberonia Aurea . If it is not made of synthetic fiber, it is the same as the clothes of ancient Oberonia Aurea .

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea thick robe
ThingDef.description: One of the common daily servings of the Oberonia Aurea. By hanging and fixing additional high-quality heavy fabrics on the belt, the entire design has both classical charm and a considerable sense of solemnity and elegance.

ThingDef.label: Assault Combat Skirt Armor
ThingDef.description:
The light armor developed by the Golden Iris Empire for raid teams in highly turbulent areas provides more reliable protection compared to windbreakers. 

The armor is equipped with high-strength specially made lightweight armor plates in the main parts, which can protect the firepower of small caliber firearms, and the parts without attached armor plates are also made of specialized dense fibers. 
In addition, the armor is equipped with two disposable grenade launchers, which perform particularly well in small-scale high-intensity combat environments.

ThingDef.label: EMP impact waistband
ThingDef.description: The technical department of the Oberonia Aurea developed a belt that can release EMP impact to counter the mechanical clan, but unfortunately, its practical effectiveness is not high, so it was not standardized for installation. \n\nWhen wearing, you can target yourself and release an EMP impact within a radius of 11 squares.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Signal Belt
ThingDef.description: After conducting research on the mechanical family, the technical department of the Oberonia Aurea has developed a belt that can increase signal and bandwidth strength, which is often used for remote control of mechanical work.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea angle ruler
ThingDef.description: A measurement and calibration tool used by the Ministry of Industry of Oberonia Aurea can improve the accuracy and efficiency of construction operations.

ThingDef.label: Learning assistance facilities
ThingDef.description: The Oberonia Aurea Palace uses a learning device with built-in complex AI that can accurately point out work errors and inform wearers of the correct approach, thereby assisting new attendants in quickly adapting to the work environment,.

ThingDef.label: Oberonia Aurea Far Walker Emergency Call Equipment
ThingDef.description: The rescue equipment developed by the Oberonia Aurea Empire for distant travelers can summon a standby raid team from their current location to rescue them in case of danger.

ThingDef.label: Rotor flight tray
ThingDef.description: A foldable transport aircraft developed by the technical department of the Oberonia Aurea for the convenience of moving objects, with a built-in voice controlled AI that can stably accompany and fly around. \n\nEven though the technical department repeatedly prohibits it, there are still occasional attendants sitting on pallets to experience ground clearance.

ThingDef.label: Heavy assault armor
ThingDef.description:
After adopting advanced military concepts and power armor culture from the Milky Way, the Golden Iris Empire combined its own technology to develop cutting-edge individual armor. 
The armor is designed with a complex sensing circuit inside, greatly reducing the wearable load, while the multi-layer impact reduction structure in the interlayer and the design of the dense armor attached have excellent firepower resistance. Even the bombardment of small caliber artillery may not cause serious damage to the wearer. In addition, the armor also incorporates the ultimate fabric produced by the cutting-edge textile technology of the Golden Iris Orchid, which further enhances its already excellent protection and gives it excellent toughness. 
However, the only drawback is that due to the complexity of the armor process and the fact that most of the required fabrics are cutting-edge products, as well as the immaturity of the corresponding production lines, even the Golden Iris Empire has not yet been able to carry out standardized assembly, and has only been allocated for raid teams in highly turbulent areas. 

Thanks to the exquisite textile craftsmanship, uranium craftsmanship, and clothing design art of the Golden Iris Orchid, this armor has extremely superior protection and can evenly distribute the impact pressure, greatly reducing the impact force. When equipping, multiply the damage coefficient by 75%. 
The cloak on the armor is woven from the ultimate fabric of the golden iris orchid, which can greatly weaken the shock wave generated by explosions in the microstructure and reduce the damage received by explosions by 25%. 
Finally, for groundbreaking considerations, the armor is also equipped with two disposable grenade launchers, making it particularly outstanding in small-scale high-intensity combat environments.

ThingDef.label: Full protective assault armor
ThingDef.description:
The Golden Iris Empire imitated and produced products after its first exposure to the power armor culture of the Milky Way. 
The protection of this armor is almost unquestionable, but the cost is that its wearable load is almost unaffordable. Due to the overly one-sided emphasis on protection, the weight of this armor has reached an astonishing level, and the simple neural sensing network is completely unable to bear this weight, resulting in a significant decrease in mobility when worn. 
However, apart from the extremely poor wearing experience, this armor can almost be called an unstoppable tower on the battlefield. 

Thanks to the thick armor plate and built-in impact reduction design, the wear resistance coefficient is reduced to 70%. 
Thanks to the thick armor plate, there will be a small amount of emotional punishment when wearing it.
